overview.goal: Own the 'science-backed supplement' space through transparent, searchable content that builds authority and captures affiliate conversions via organic search.
overview.positioning: We are the thinking person's supplement marketplace—education-first, proof-driven, no fluff.
overview.voice_alignment: Educational (explain the science), bold (confident in results), urgent (energy/weight are quality-of-life), transparent (honest about what works).

content_pillars.title: Weight-Loss Science & Strategy
content_pillars.rationale: Capture 'how to lose weight' intent at scale. Our curation story differentiates us from generic supplement sites.

topics: How to lose weight sustainably (guide to realistic timelines, expectations)
Weight loss myths debunked (calorie myth, detox myth, spot reduction, etc.)
The science behind why supplements help weight loss (mechanism of action primer)
Best supplements for weight loss (buyer's guide, ranked by clinical evidence)
GLP-1 alternatives: do they work? (emerging medicines, efficacy overview)
Thermogenic supplements: science vs. hype (what actually works)
Appetite suppressants: natural vs. prescription
How to stack supplements for weight loss (layering strategy)
Supplement timing: when to take them for max efficacy
Diet + supplements: how to combine them for results

content_pillars.title: Energy & Vitality
content_pillars.rationale: Complement weight loss with energy/mood positioning. High intent ('why am I tired,' 'how to boost energy') + natural product tie-in.

topics: Why you're always tired: 7 real reasons (and what supplements can fix)
Energy crashes explained (blood sugar, dopamine, sleep debt)
Nutrition for sustained energy (micronutrient gaps, supplementation)
Best supplements for energy and focus (ranked by mechanism, not marketing)
B vitamins for energy: which ones actually work
Adaptogens for stress and energy (ashwagandha, rhodiola, etc.—with studies)
Recovery supplements for active people (post-workout, DOMS, sleep)
Supplements for athletic performance (creatine, beta-alanine, tested formulas)

content_pillars.title: Transparency & Curation (Brand Differentiation)
content_pillars.rationale: This pillar is unique to us. It builds trust and justifies premium affiliate conversions.

topics: How we choose supplements (our curation framework—efficacy-first, no marketing BS)
Why we exclude supplements (our rejection criteria)
Supplement quality: what actually matters (GMP, third-party testing, transparency)
Supplements vs. prescription weight-loss medicines (trade-offs, when each makes sense)
Brand comparison: supplement marketplace A vs. B vs. Health & Care (honest benchmarking)
Natural vs. synthetic supplements (efficacy, safety, evidence)
Reading a supplement label: what to look for (ingredients, dosing, certifications)
Understanding clinical studies (how to read research, spotting marketing claims)
Supplement safety: interactions, contraindications, when to ask a doctor

content_pillars.title: Real Results & Community (Social Proof)
content_pillars.rationale: Decision-stage content. Before/afters, testimonials, case studies create trust and drive conversions.

topics: Customer transformations (before/afters with specific timelines, products used, habits)
How long does weight loss take? (realistic expectations, graphed progress)
Energy transformation stories (from 'exhausted' to 'energized')
Common questions about Health & Care (why us, how we work, guarantees)
Will supplements work for me? (honest assessment of who sees results)
Supplement side effects: what to expect and when to pause
Success stories from our community (monthly highlights, featured customers)
Supplement reviews from users (aggregated, honest, with ratings)

content_pillars.title: Start Here: Implementation & Onboarding
content_pillars.rationale: Conversion-stage content. 'How to start' articles bridge research to purchase.

topics: Your first supplement: which to choose (persona-matched recommendations)
How to start supplements (setup guide, dosing, tracking progress)
Supplement storage & safety (how to keep them effective)
Not seeing results? Here's why (and how to adjust)
Supplement stacking for weight loss (layering multiple products safely)
30-day supplement challenge (with tracking sheet)
Supplements + diet: how to layer them (macros, meal timing, synergy)
Supplements + exercise: what to take when (pre/intra/post-workout)
Sustaining results: the long game (cycling, maintenance, prevention)

publishing_cadence.notes: Publish 3 major pieces per month. Interlink aggressively. Promote via email (nurture) and social (Instagram, Facebook). Monitor search rankings monthly; optimize underperforming pieces at month 3 and 6.

content_differentiation.what_competitors_do: List '10 Best Supplements' with surface-level claims and affiliate links.
content_differentiation.what_we_do_instead: Explain the science, rank by clinical evidence, and show the mechanism of action. Include what we DON'T recommend and why. Builds authority.

content_differentiation.what_competitors_do: Vague language ('This supplement changed my life').
content_differentiation.what_we_do_instead: Transparent metrics and timelines. 'Jane lost 22 lbs in 12 weeks using [specific stack] + diet + exercise.' Includes the diet/exercise part (honest).
Challenge myths directly. 'The natural supplement is actually less bioavailable. Here's the study.' Bold, trusted, contrarian.
Transparency pillar shows HOW we choose, why we reject products, what our standards are. Unique to us, builds differentiation.
Inclusive 25-70 positioning. Content for busy professionals (energy), active people (recovery), and weight-loss seekers. Broader TAM.

organic_search.tactic: SEO — target keywords across all 5 pillars. Build internal link structure (hub/spoke). Publish at 3/month cadence.
organic_search.goal: Rank for 10-15 primary keywords + 20+ long-tail variants within 6 months.

email_nurture.tactic: Segment by stage. Awareness (send educational pieces: Myths, Why Tired). Consideration (send buyer's guides: Best For Weight Loss, Best For Energy). Decision (send testimonials, FAQ, How to Start).
email_nurture.goal: Nurture 80%+ of email list to purchase within 90 days.

social_proof.tactic: Instagram & Facebook: post transformation stories, carousel guides, myth-busting graphics, quotes from guides.
social_proof.goal: Link to blog pieces. Build community engagement. Monthly customer feature.

paid_social.tactic: Meta ads (Facebook/Instagram) + budget coordinated with /strategy-brief campaigns. Target awareness-stage content (Myths, Why Tired) to cold audiences. Testimonial/How to Start to warm audiences.
paid_social.goal: Blend organic + paid: organic search captures the 'high intent' buyer; paid amplifies awareness-stage content to build funnel.

partnerships_collaborations.tactic: Guest post on fitness/health blogs (contribute 'Best Supplements' guide with backlinks to ours). Interview fitness influencers (link to our content). Reddit AMAs in r/fitness, r/loseit.
partnerships_collaborations.goal: Build backlinks, referral traffic, authority signals.

content_production_workflow.step_1_planning: Define pillar + keyword + buyer stage + angle (1-2 hours)
content_production_workflow.step_2_research: Gather studies, competitive benchmarks, customer insights (2-4 hours)
content_production_workflow.step_3_outline: Create detailed outline with h2s, internal links, data visualizations (1 hour)
content_production_workflow.step_4_draft: Write or AI-assist draft (using /creative skill) (2-3 hours)
content_production_workflow.step_5_science_check: Verify claims against studies, fact-check (1 hour)
content_production_workflow.step_6_brand_voice_polish: Ensure educational + bold + urgent + transparent tone (1 hour)
content_production_workflow.step_7_internal_linking: Map to other pieces, craft CTAs (30 minutes)
content_production_workflow.step_8_publication: Upload to blog, set publish date, schedule social/email (30 minutes)
content_production_workflow.step_9_tracking: Set up GA4 goal, add to tracking spreadsheet (15 minutes)
content_production_workflow.frequency_goal: 3 pieces/month = 27-39 hours/month = 6-10 hours/week for one writer + 2-3 hours/week for brand oversight
